good: Clear knockout action with visible opponent impact—inherently engaging fight content
Fighter name and result displayed prominently with UFC branding for credibility
High-contrast visuals (purple gear against dark octagon) keeps subject in focus
Emotional celebration reaction shot adds human element and victory resonance
bad: Average watch time 5.8s is significantly below target—viewers dropping off before completion
Engagement rate 5.1% is below-benchmark for fight content (aim 8-12%+)
Shares and saves minimal (18 and 10)—content not triggering save-to-collection behavior
Caption purely informational with no emotional hook, question, or call-to-action
reels.top_tip: Front-load the knockout impact into the first 1–2 seconds of the hook, then cut faster through the first 10s to maintain momentum and push completion rate from 5.8s to 12+ seconds
